run_boost_build_make_rule_test: run the BoostBuild test script that validates the make rule creates targets with custom features
test_boost_make_rule_feature_flags: test that the make rule correctly passes feature flags like test_feature to the creator action
verify_boost_build_target_creation: verify that running the build system creates the expected bin/foo.bar output file with correct content
test_boost_build_regression_duplicate_ta: test the regression case where a main target requested twice with incidental property differences is created only once
run_boost_build_copy_action_test: run the build system with dry-run flags to verify the copy action executes exactly once for duplicate targets
